decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an upgrade of an established trommel screen that the website says already has a loyal following, so its results likely meet aspirations in Doppstadt's core screening segment.
The AK flail shredder series is core to the firm's composting and green-waste business and was recently updated to EU Stage V engines, a sign of ongoing commitment that makes dropping it unlikely.

The mobile high-speed grinder gained its own page in 2019 and fits the core mobile wood and biomass business, so it likely performs well enough to keep despite limited slack after the firm's restructuring.

The CERON generation has a cited reference installation and claims to set standards, but stationary plants are a riskier niche for a slack-constrained firm, so dropping it is a moderate risk, though keeping it is more likely.
